toolInvocations.description: Read 44 numeric issue-run JSON files on main, parse toolInvocations arrays, and aggregate invocation totals by issue and tool identifier; no repository data was changed.
toolInvocations.intent: Analyze existing AGENTS Procedure issue-run records and toolInvocations arrays to identify observed tools and invocation syntax, then distinguish data creation, mutation, and deletion from reads or conditional commands.
